description.value: Rocanini Coffee Roasters is an artisan coffee company established in 2010, its name derived from the Latin word for 'rock' in homage to Italian tradition — evoking a foundation of strength and presence. Beyond handcrafted beverages, the cafe sells freshly roasted coffee beans, tea, and brewing equipment on-site. The company also runs a wholesale operation and offers private cupping and barista training for those pursuing a deeper coffee education.
